title: EPIC: per-service AWS parity audit campaign (behavior, LocalStack parity, cross-service integration, performance, resource leaks)
audit services/stepfunctions for AWS parity, performance and leaks
description:
Audit dimensions (all five, report CLEAN explicitly where it applies):
1. AWS behavior compliance - wire shape, error codes, field names verified against pinned aws-sdk-go-v2 source, not from memory.
2. LocalStack parity - behaviour differences a client would observe.
3. Cross-service integration - resources this service references in others.
4. Performance - hot paths, allocations, lock contention, O(n) scans under lock.
5. Resource leaks - goroutines, timers, file handles, unbounded maps/slices.
Every bug found gets its own bd issue AND a regression test that fails before the fix.
lint + CI must pass before the service is closed.
